title:
Epic triggered by the ´INITIAL_RENDER´ action of the `Reliability.CreateMetricSettingsAndPermissionsForm` and
components.
Is use to check if the metric being configured is a new metric or an existing metric. In case of a new metric,
the epic will prepopulate the metric configuration form with the default values.
Default values are:
- Metric Name: Empty string
- Metric Description: Empty string
- Metric Permission: 'Public'
name: InitialPrepopulateCreateMetricComponentsEpic
